title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Placing Your First Buy and Sell Orders

questions.text: Which statement accurately describes a market order?
options: It executes instantly at the current best price, prioritizing speed over price control.
It sets a specific price limit and only executes if the market reaches that price.
It guarantees the exact price you see when placing the order.
It eliminates any risk of slippage.
questions.explanation: Market orders prioritize immediate execution at the prevailing price, accepting possible slippage.

questions.text: True or false: A limit order will always be filled eventually because it waits for the market to reach your specified price.
questions.explanation: A limit order may never fill if the market never reaches the set price.
